remarks: Just Listed: Charming 4-Bedroom Home in the Compo Beach Area! Walk to Old Mill and Compo Beach from this 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom home, nestled perfectly on a level .53-acre lot in a serene setting. This renovated gem is tucked away on a quiet, private road, offering both tranquility and convenience. Situated in the sought-after Compo Beach area, this home is a mere 2 miles from Metro North and minutes from I-95, making it an ideal commuter location. As you enter, you'll be captivated by the open floor plan and the seamless flow of space. The home features hardwood floors, enhancing its charm and elegance. The updated kitchen boasts a large center island and is open to the living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and a dining area with French doors that overlook your expansive private backyard. The main level houses three spacious bedrooms. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a private full bath. The lower level features the fourth bedroom, a full bath, a laundry room, and a family room with another wood-burning fireplace. The lower level has French doors that open to a large deck, perfect for sunning, dining, and entertaining. The large backyard offers a peaceful and private retreat. This home includes an attached two-car garage, a mudroom area, and central air conditioning for year-round comfort. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to call Westport, CT home! Experience the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this beautiful residence.
